		fib daddr type local counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump DOCKER
	}

	chain INPUT {
		type nat hook input priority 100; policy accept;
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type nat hook output priority -100; policy accept;
		ip6 daddr != ::1 fib daddr type local counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump DOCKER
	}

	chain POSTROUTING {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		counter packets 503893 bytes 43167890 jump LIBVIRT_PRT
		counter packets 506843 bytes 43440192 jump ts-postrouting
	}

	chain DOCKER {
	}

	chain ts-postrouting {
		mark and 0xff0000 == 0x40000 counter packets 0 bytes 0 masquerade  
	}

	chain LIBVIRT_PRT {
	}
}
table ip raw {
	chain PREROUTING {
		type filter hook prerouting priority raw; policy accept;
		iifname != "docker0" ip daddr 172.17.0.2 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		iifname != "docker0" ip daddr 172.17.0.3 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		iifname != "lo" meta l4proto tcp ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 25500 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		iifname != "docker0" ip daddr 172.17.0.4 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		iifname != "lo" meta l4proto tcp ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 29011 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}
}
table inet sandbox {
	set guest_net_laojun {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 10.9.0.0/24 }
	}

	set guest_net_jinjiao {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 10.9.1.0/24 }
	}

	set mirror_ustc {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 202.38.95.110, 202.141.160.110,
			     218.104.71.170 }
	}

	set mirror_gitlab {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 61.169.144.123 }
	}

	set mirror_npm {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 119.188.172.139, 140.207.247.168 }
	}

	set mirror_ustc6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		elements = { 2001:da8:d800:95::110 }
	}

	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter + 10; policy accept;
		ip saddr @guest_net_laojun jump sandbox_policy_laojun
		ip saddr @guest_net_jinjiao jump sandbox_policy_jinjiao
	}

	chain sandbox_policy_laojun {
		ip daddr 10.0.0.0/8 accept
		ip daddr 172.16.0.0/12 accept
		ip daddr 192.168.0.0/16 accept
		ip daddr 172.16.24.8 udp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr 172.16.24.8 tcp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr 223.5.5.5 udp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr 223.5.5.5 tcp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr @mirror_ustc accept
		ip daddr @mirror_gitlab accept
		ip6 daddr @mirror_ustc6 accept
		ip daddr @mirror_npm accept
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}

	chain sandbox_policy_jinjiao {
		ip daddr 10.0.0.0/8 accept
		ip daddr 172.16.0.0/12 accept
		ip daddr 192.168.0.0/16 accept
		ip daddr 172.16.24.8 udp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr 172.16.24.8 tcp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr 223.5.5.5 udp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr 223.5.5.5 tcp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr @mirror_ustc accept
		ip daddr @mirror_gitlab accept
		ip6 daddr @mirror_ustc6 accept
		ip daddr @mirror_npm accept
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}

	chain postrouter {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		ip saddr 10.9.0.0/24 oifname != "tailscale0" masquerade
		ip saddr 10.9.1.0/24 oifname != "tailscale0" masquerade
	}
}
